correctness.rationale: PASS. For each n≥2, vertices are labeled permutations, deletion retains labels and order. Adjacent permutations have inversion disagreement graph a nonempty star. For any triple of permutations, pairwise disagreement edge sets have symmetric difference zero; classification of three nonempty stars forces either a common center (unique common deletion symbol) or a triangle of three two-edge stars on three symbols. In exceptional case the marked symbols form the three cyclic orders within a consecutive length-three block. Common-read triangles count n! binom(n,3) and exceptional triples n!(n−2)/3, giving n!(n−2)(n²−n+2)/6. Degree is (n−1)²; clustering coefficient equals (n²−n+2)/[n(n−1)²] for n≥3, undefined n=2. Independent brute-force literal-label deletion through n=6 produced 0,8,112,1320,15360 triangles and correct degrees, and brute enumerated the three-star lemma configurations at small n. Finite checks only corroborate the all-n classification proof.
residual_risks: The theorem crucially retains actual symbol labels (not standardized patterns); changing model invalidates counts.
Independent enumeration checks n≤6, not the infinite quantifier.
